title: Arms become branches
summary: One gesture, held for nearly three centuries: the moment Daphne stops being a woman, her arms already laurel as Apollo reaches her.

stops.note: Her arms are already two laurel boughs while Apollo still holds her.
Leaves break from her fingers and bark closes over her legs as his hand reaches her side.
Her father, the river Peneus, sits below with his oar as laurel breaks from her raised hand.
